newsitem.title: USA: Viacom exploring sale of radio stations - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Viacom exploring sale of radio stations - WSJ.

text.p: Viacom Inc is exploring the sale of individual stations in its 10-station group, the Wall Street Journal said Wednesday.
The paper said people familiar with the situation said Viacom met with Walt Disney about selling the group for close to $1 billion, but Disney was prepared to offer only around $700 million.
The report said analysts value Viacom's station group at between $700 million and $900 million and believe Viacom could get the sum by selling its stations separately.

It said bids for Viacom's individual stations are due next week and that companies including Westinghouse, Disney, Evergreen Media, Emmis Broadcasting, Jacor Communications and SFX Broadcasting are expected to look at the properties.
